evidence_boundaries.pseudo_locale: Pseudo-localized strings test growth and wrapping only; they do not validate translation quality, grammar, cultural fit, or locale formatting.
evidence_boundaries.rtl: Setting Arabic content and document direction tests this reproduced DOM and CSS render, not linguistic quality or every bidirectional edge case.
evidence_boundaries.text_200: The author stylesheet doubles declared text sizes for deterministic text-only stress. It is not browser zoom, OS text scaling, or user settings.
evidence_boundaries.reflow_320: A 320 CSS px viewport is direct narrow-reflow evidence. It is not proof of 400% browser zoom from a 1280 px viewport.
evidence_boundaries.overflow: Page metrics and the first viewport capture do not prove below-fold reachability, nested scrolling, focus visibility, or every content value.
